name: zsms-monorepo
description: ZSMS — school management SaaS by AfriTech Systems Limited

scripts.ci:checks: npm run db:check:migrations && npm run db:test:plans && npm run gaps && npm run gaps:mobile && npm run test:unit && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run build

//react: Declared at the root ONLY to control npm hoisting, not because the root builds anything. Every workspace is now on React 19 — apps/mobile moved with Expo SDK 57 (React Native 0.86.3 peer-requires ^19.2.3), so the old two-majors problem is gone. It stays pinned here because `styled-jsx`, a transitive dependency of `next`, hoists to the root and resolves React from it; without a root pin npm is free to put a second copy there and prerendering fails with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useContext')`. One version everywhere is the whole point.
//types-react: Pinned through `overrides` so every hoisted package compiles against the same React types. A stale @types/react 18 survived at the root from the SDK-52 era and react-native's own types resolved against it, which made every class component 'not a valid JSX element type'.
//overrides: @clerk/nextjs declares `next` as a peer, so npm auto-installs the newest satisfying version (16.x) at the workspace root. That put a second Next.js — and, before apps/web moved to React 19, a second React major — in the same tree as apps/web, which surfaced as a null-useContext prerender failure. Pin Clerk's peer to the version apps/web actually runs. Scoped deliberately: apps/mobile must stay on the React 18.3.1 that Expo 52 requires, so a global override is not safe here.
//native-singletons: The react-native-* and expo-* entries in `overrides` exist because each holds singleton state on the native side and MUST appear exactly once. `@clerk/clerk-expo` and `expo-router` hoist a dozen Expo packages to the root, where loose peers like `react-native-gesture-handler: "*"` resolved to 3.3.0 while apps/mobile pinned 2.32.0 — incompatible majors, with expo-router/drawer using one and the app initialising the other. Every drawer and tab layout threw. Versions are whatever `expo install` picks for SDK 57, which is the set Expo tests together.
